subject.title: Remote skill bin probe times out when node is co-located with gateway (macOS app as node on same host)

question: Should macOS app-backed nodes be probed immediately on connect, probed only after a readiness/deferred backoff signal, or skipped when co-located with the gateway?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the durable fix crosses macOS app readiness, co-located-node policy, retry/backoff behavior, and remote skill availability rather than a purely mechanical code repair.

options.title: Defer And Back Off Probes
options.body: Keep remote macOS skills supported, but delay initial app-node probes until readiness is stronger and add bounded retry/backoff for failed probes.

options.title: Skip Co-located App Nodes
options.body: Avoid loopback/co-located app-node probes while preserving remote app-node probing for hosts that can execute skills.

options.title: Disable App-node Probing By Default
options.body: Stop automatic app-node remote skill eligibility unless users explicitly enable it, reducing warnings at the cost of default remote skill support.

recommendation.title: Defer And Back Off Probes
recommendation.body: Keep remote macOS skills supported, but delay initial app-node probes until readiness is stronger and add bounded retry/backoff for failed probes.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant active probe, node command policy, and macOS app-node command-surface history most strongly route through steipete's current and feature-history commits.
